detailed_description: AI Prompt Generator creates structured prompt drafts for writing, coding, analysis, and marketing tasks. It combines a role, objective, audience, output format, constraints, and practical instruction checklist into one copy-ready prompt. The generator is template-based and runs in the browser; it does not call an AI model or send your prompt to an external API.
usage_steps: Choose the task type: writing, coding, analysis, or marketing.
Enter the topic, target audience, tone, output format, and constraints.
Review the generated role, objective, audience, format, constraints, and instruction sections.
Copy the prompt and paste it into your preferred AI tool or internal workflow.
usage_examples: Build a coding prompt that asks for implementation steps, examples, and caveats.
Create a marketing prompt for a launch plan aimed at a specific audience.
Turn a broad writing idea into a structured prompt with format and constraint guidance.

faqs.question: Is AI Prompt Generator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool is free to use in your browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does the tool upload my inputs?
faqs.answer: No. The prompt draft is generated locally in your browser.

faqs.question: Does AI Prompt Generator call an AI model?
faqs.answer: No. This tool uses local templates and formatting logic in your browser; it does not call an AI model or external API.

faqs.question: Can I use the generated prompt directly?
faqs.answer: Yes, but review the topic, constraints, and output format so the prompt matches your real task and quality bar.
